entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I thought it would just be you coming,[n]Takamaki-san.
entries.uk: Я гадав, що ви прийдете сама,[n]Такамакі.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wouldn't you get nervous too, if it was[n]just the two of us?
entries.uk: А ти б не нервував, якби ми були[n]тільки вдвох?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're here to keep an eye on you, so[n]don't try anything perverted, 'kay?
entries.uk: Ми тут, щоб за тобою наглядати,[n]тож без збочень, ясно?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Stop making such odd assumptions.[n]I have absolutely no interest in her as[n]someone of the opposite sex.
entries.uk: Облиште ці дивні припущення.[n]Вона анітрохи не цікавить мене[n]як особа протилежної статі.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is there a problem?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...No, not really.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well then, let's get started.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Hey.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kitagawa-kun?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You hear her?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...It's no use.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This isn't what we planned! We were[n]gonna catch him off guard and make him[n]spill his beans, weren't we?
entries.uk: Ми ж не так планували! Хіба ми не мали[n]заскочити його зненацька, щоб він[n]усе вибовкав?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How were we supposed to know this was[n]gonna happen?
entries.uk: А звідки нам було знати, що так вийде?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess we just gotta wait 'til he's done...[n]What an effin' pain in the ass...
entries.uk: Мабуть, доведеться чекати, доки[n]він закінчить... От же ж клята морока...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Perhaps I should try going outside[n]this room...
Don't get caught.
Stay put.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heh, who do you think you're talking to?
entries.uk: Хе, ти з ким, по-твоєму, говориш?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just waiting around is a waste of time!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is too boring, so I'm going to scout[n]around a bit.
entries.uk: Тут надто нудно, тож я трохи[n]розвідаю, що й де.
